[[Syncretic politics|Syncretic political movements]] are hybrids of disparate political philosophies, such as the [[People's Mujahedin of Iran]], who mix [[Marxism]] and [[Islam]], the [[Third Way]], which fuses [[Social democracy|social-democratic]] and [[neoliberal]] elements, and [[Christian democracy]], which combines [[conservative]] ideas with some economically [[centre-left]] policies.
